note: Release record for the materialised Datalog inference over the full LinguaScrape convergence corpus (US-004). 'base_relations' counts the edge predicates the shared rules read; 'derived_relations' is the engine-free fixpoint extension of each rule (culturescrape.datalog.materialize). These TYPE counts are the DETERMINISTIC fingerprint of the derivation over this corpus; they track the live corpus, so regenerate with the command in docs/convergence-build.md 'Materialize Datalog inference at scale (US-004)' after any rebuild. The corpus and its corpus-datalog export are gitignored. genetic_linguistic_correlation is 0 here because LinguaScrape ships no genetics domain (no haplogroup source); the rule materialises on a merged corpus that includes one -- see the shipped genetic-linguistic-correlation example over the bundled fixture.
